# Write to target path without index

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_11/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_11/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on 'city'
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="city", how="inner")

# Group by 'city' (primary key)
# Aggregations:
# - fare: mean (float)
# - ride_id: mean (float)
# - driver_count: max (integer, to avoid summing driver counts which are per city)
result = joined.groupby("city", as_index=False).agg({
    "fare": "mean",
    "ride_id": "mean",
    "driver_count": "max"
})

# Ensure column order and types as target schema
result = result[["city", "fare", "ride_id", "driver_count"]]
result["driver_count"] = result["driver_count"].astype(int)

# Write output
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_11/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
